topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I reckon the touch of the earth runs deep, and so does the bond of trust. When a young scholar takes the words of another for his own, it's like the seed sown not by his hand, yet reaped as if his toil. The soil teaches us that what we sow, we must also tend to; no harvest comes true without the honest sweat. The elders taught, and I hold dear, that every man's words and deeds are his own mark. May the Saint of Truth guide him to see that in the end, the heart's mercy is sweeter than any false gain.
